title: Group Room Blocks Addendum Allowances and Availability
content:
Group Room Blocks contracts set, per block type, the free-reduction percentage (the share of the originally contracted room nights that may be removed by signed addendum without changing the attrition basis), the free-reduction deadline (the calendar days before arrival up to which a free reduction may be signed) and whether room nights added by addendum depend on the hotel's availability.

| Block type | Free-reduction percentage (% of the originally contracted room nights) | Free-reduction deadline (calendar days before arrival) | Added room nights subject to the hotel's availability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 10 | 60 | Yes |
| Wedding Room Block | 10 | 90 | Yes |
| Sports Team Room Block | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 15 | 45 | Yes |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 10 | 60 | Yes |
| Association Convention Room Block | 5 | 120 | Yes |

### Notes to the schedule

- The deadline is a count of calendar days back from the arrival date.
- Availability governs added room nights on every block type.

### Reading a row (hypothetical blocks)

An Association Convention Room Block originally contracted for 1,000 room nights shows a free-reduction percentage of 5, which corresponds to 50 room nights, and a deadline 120 calendar days before arrival. A Sports Team Room Block originally contracted for 100 room nights shows 20 percent, corresponding to 20 room nights, with a deadline 30 calendar days before arrival.
